mapper.insert: insert into warehouse (warehouse_code, name, type, address, contact_name, contact_phone, status, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{warehouseCode}, #{name}, #{type}, #{address}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update warehouse set is_del = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select id, warehouse_code, name, type, address, contact_name, contact_phone, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from warehouse where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.update: update warehouse set warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode}, name = #{name}, type = #{type}, address = #{address}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
